title: Elastikchain
tagline: A plateforme to help Kickstart startups working on DApps.
description:
Elastikchain is plateforme that will allow startups to post their ideas(white paper) with an MVP and sponsors can put prices for each categories people will be able to vote on projects they like which will release the funds for a winner (only 15% at first) and then the project will go to the next step where they need to complete a milestone to get further funds. 
investors can step up anytime and sign a contract that will also follow the rules on our smart contarct for funding by milestone.
how_its_made:
This project use @Ethereum and is coded with @Solidity.

Thir-party APIs are used to get data about the projects posted on the platform.

The idea is to port the project to near protocol or the use of the bridge.



The contract is made to be easy to understand and also gives so many parameters to the owner in order to satisfy his needs.
